ABSTRACT:
A toothbrush handle, and toothbrush incorporating the same, wherein the handle comprises a stem to be slidably inserted into a refill head. An aperture in the stem defines a latch having a locking lug that operably mates with a locking lug of the refill head to axially retain the refill head to the handle. A resilient material seals the aperture to provide increased rigidity to the latch.

ABSTRACT:
An electronic device has multiple sides. In some implementations, at least two of the sides are pivotable with respect to one another. The device may have a display that wraps from one side to the other. In some implementations, the device has multiple display drivers and each display driver is responsible for driving a different pixel region. The device may enable and disable one or more of the drivers based on an angle between the sides of the device.
